ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, point $D$ is on the extension of $AB$, and $C$ is a point on $\odot O$. Given that $\angle A=25^\circ$ and $\angle D=40^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle DOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $OA = OC$, $\angle A = 25^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle A = \angle OCA = 25^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle DOC = 2\angle A = \boxed{50^\circ}$.
